history.summary: A brand-new (2025) freehold 4BR at Mori, D14, but only 1,023sqft — a compressed 'compact 4BR' — asking $1,906 psf, a ~4% premium to the new-launch-inflated $1,827 median. The URA rate is negative (-0.45%/yr) and flagged with new-launch bias, so the development is showing no resale momentum and the low score_1000 (306) reflects genuinely weak value.
history.rating_rationale: Negative appreciation (-0.45%/yr) even on a 140-txn series, with explicit new-launch bias, means buyers who entered at launch are underwater — a poor sign for a 5-7yr hold. A 1,023sqft '4BR' is functionally cramped and a niche resale product, and the $1,906 psf still sits ~4% above the (inflated) median. Freehold and 630m to Aljunied don't rescue a development with no demonstrated price support. Lowest-conviction value pick in the batch.
